title: Numerical monomial on a subset indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S$ and $U$ be subsets of its coordinates. The numerical monomial indexed by $S$, evaluated at the binary vector equal to $1$ precisely on $U$, is $1$ if $S\\subseteq U$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ and $U$ are subsets of the $n$ coordinates
